Halcyon Robotics raises EUR 6 million

Halcyon Robotics has raised EUR 6 million in a seed round led by Baltic Robotics Fund.

Halcyon Robotics AB is headquartered in Gothenburg, Sweden. The company builds software for warehouse robots that pick and pack orders.

The Nordic software market has grown steadily as companies across the region adopt cloud tools, and investors have kept writing early cheques for teams with paying customers.
